 Lumbini Lions vs Pokhara Avengers Preview & Prediction | 2026 Nepal Premier League | League Stage
 by Alex Sarwar · 2 November 2026 at 10:59 am 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 After failing to get out onto the field against Chitwan Rhinos, Lumbini Lions try again here, this time against struggling Pokhara Avengers. 
 Date & time: 
 3 November 2026 at 10:45 am 
 Venue:  Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur, Nepal
 Weather:  Dry with conditions getting colder as the sun sets, temperatures dropping well below 20c.
 How to watch:  UK – NETTV App / USA – NETTV App / Nepal – Himalaya Sports Network and NETTV App
 Will Pokhara Avengers fall to a third straight NPL defeat?
 Open poll and results 
 Lumbini Lions vs Pokhara Avengers prediction 
 Lumbini Lions had their last game against Chitwan Rhinos washed out, but that doesn’t change the fact that it’s been a good start to the tournament. They are well placed in the table with three points from two matches and a very high net run rate. This serves as an excellent opportunity to increase that tally against a Pokhara Avengers side who are rock bottom of the table.
 As it stands, the Avengers are the only team yet to put a victory on the board, having lost to both Sudurpaschim Royals and, most recently, Janakpur Bolts. While Pokhara put up a good fight against the Bolts, ultimately a target of 148 proved too much for them, as they finished on 138/9.
 But Pokhara are running into a very strong Lumbini side, who are already established as one of the best in the competition. The Lions’ top order looked impressive when they were last able to play, and a similar story is expected this time around. Ultimately, it would be a surprise if Lumbini weren’t to get the better of Pokhara.
 Lumbini Lions vs Pokhara Avengers tip:  Lumbini Lions to win
